verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own export paths: transcripts, summaries and metadata can be exported to an Amazon S3 bucket, synced to Google Drive for backup, and pulled out through its public API. However, nothing shows a complete account-level export or which formats the files use, so whether you can take all your data in open formats and leave is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export (including audio recordings), named open file formats (e.g. TXT/SRT/JSON), and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export before leaving.
